items.meta_title: White-Label VPN: Run Your Own VPN Brand | VpnHood!
items.meta_description: Put your own name, apps and prices on a VPN built to beat censorship. Your website, Google Play and the App Store all feed your own store; we build all of it.
items.page_desc: Your customers buy on your website, on Google Play or on the App Store. Every order lands in your store, your store gets the access code from us, and your app puts it on their devices. We build all of it; you put your name on it.
items.hero_alt: A phone with a blank app icon and an empty name plate, a price tag on its corner and three colour swatches
items.diagram_title: Every sale ends up in your store
items.diagram_desc: Purchases from your website, Google Play and the App Store all land in your store. Your store orders access codes from VpnHood!, which stays invisible to your customer, and your own app signs in to your store and receives the code.
items.diagram_caption: we build all of it; you put your name on it
items.layers_title: Three layers, and you can stop at any of them
items.layers_desc: The plumbing never changes: an order in your store is paid from your prepaid credit with us, an access code is issued, and your customer gets it. What changes is how much of the experience carries your name, and where your customers can buy.
items.l1_desc: This is VpnHood! PARTNER, and it is the whole of layer one. Your customers buy on your site, receive an access code in your client area, and use it in the app. The storefront, the invoices, the emails and the support are all yours; we never appear in the transaction.
items.l2_desc: The client app is open source, and its whole visual identity lives in one bundled package, so your build is your name, icon, colours and package id on top of the engine we maintain. Your customers sign in to your store from inside your app, or on your website, and the code reaches their devices without them ever typing it. We build the app for you.
items.l2_note_title: Two things to know before you start
items.l2_note_1: The apps are published from your own Google Play and Apple developer accounts. The stores tie in-app products and payouts to the publisher, so the account has to be yours.
items.l2_note_2: Your app inherits engine fixes when it is rebuilt on a new release, and the open-source licence terms travel with the code.
items.l3_desc: With your own app in place, your customers can buy inside it. Google or Apple pays you, and the purchase becomes a normal order in your store: the customer, the order and the paid invoice are created for you, the access code is issued from your credit, and the app receives it straight away.
items.l3_sync: Renewals, cancellations and refunds arrive from the stores and keep the service, the invoice and the code in step, including revoking a refunded purchase. App-store sales, web sales and support all live in the one store you already run.
items.l3_need_desc: In-app purchases are always paid to the app's publisher, so these are your accounts and nobody else can provide them: a Google Play Console and an App Store Connect account, with API access for each. We connect them for you.
items.start_desc: Nothing built at layer one has to be rebuilt later, so the usual path is to open a partner account, sell from your website first, and add your app once the sales are real. Talk to us before you start on the app and we will build it around your brand.
items.cta: Thinking about a brand of your own? Tell us what you have in mind.
